items.title: Frank Goudie Interview
items.q: He also mentioned Stan Kenton. And that was the future music, what he told me.

ctx.x: It's an instrument I love to play. You say you have some of these in your collection. Yeah. Oh, go ahead, Frank, and give me some of your opinions on the... All broad generalizations on the status of jazz now and...

Well, my opinion... I told Dolaunay in Paris, when he brought in those records from Gillespie over, he called me up and told me to come up and listen to him. Yeah. And I spent about two hours at the hot club of Paris, which he called himself the President of... Yeah. And I listened to it. I didn't say nothing. So when he finished, I asked him who was Gillespie. He said, well, he's a modern musician, and Charlie Parker. I didn't know about those two guys. Yeah. He also mentioned Stan Kenton. And that was the…
